span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Because the hippocampus receives polymodal rather than unimodal input, it is positioned to combine the cortex's stimulus-selective signals into complex conjunctions or to abstract a general output signal from them, which is why its mnemonic code is abstracted rather than stimulus-specific
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: The occasional stimulus-selective, cortex-type recognition signals seen in the hippocampus are inherited through the direct anatomical projections from perirhinal and entorhinal cortex to area CA1
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: At long delays interference builds up, so contextual/episodic conjunctive information becomes the useful cue for recognition, which is why hippocampal damage bites hardest at long delays
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: Cortical stimulus-stimulus association works by a cue acquiring the capacity to generate the neural representation of the stimulus it was paired with, producing pair-coding and pair-recall firing
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The parahippocampal/postrhinal cortex is excluded from the review because too little is known about its mnemonic activity.
span.note: what this limits: the anatomical coverage of the review, and the field's coverage it reflects: MUCH LESS IS KNOWN ABOUT THE PATTERNS OF MNEMONIC ACTIVITY IN THE PARAHIPPOCAMPAL/POSTRHINAL CORTEX, AND THEREFORE THIS REGION WILL NOT BE DISCUSSED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: No direct comparison exists that would identify which testing conditions produce similar versus different coding in cortex and hippocampus.
span.note: what this limits: any comparison across testing conditions: A COMPELLING DIRECT COMPARISON THAT REVEALS THE CRITICAL ASPECTS OF THESE DIFFERENT TESTING CONDITIONS HAS YET TO BE MADE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The scope of associative-memory signals across the medial temporal lobe is not yet established.
span.note: what this limits: the reach of the associative-memory account: ADDITIONAL COMPARATIVE STUDIES ARE NEEDED TO DETERMINE THE FULL SCOPE OF NEURAL SIGNALS UNDERLYING ASSOCIATIVE MEMORY ACROSS THE MEDIAL TEMPORAL LOBE
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: A specific empirical gap: intervening stimuli have not been tested against selective delay activity in rat perirhinal/entorhinal cortex.
span.note: what this limits: the rat delay-activity literature specifically: THE EFFECT OF INTERVENING STIMULI ON THE SELECTIVE DELAY ACTIVITY IN THE PERIRHINAL OR ENTORHINAL CORTICES OF RATS HAS NOT BEEN EXAMINED
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The anatomy is used to support two opposite expectations, both stated in the same passage.
span.note: what this limits: any finding of regional difference in the medial temporal lobe: the review argues from differing convergent cortical input that each area may be characterised by distinct patterns of mnemonic activity, and separately argues from parallel projections that all these regions access similar information
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: How many neurons show the effect depends on which version of the task was run.
span.note: what this limits: any proportion of match-enhancement neurons quoted from this work: the proportion was substantially higher during the ABBA version of the task than during the standard version
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The neuropsychological literature is stated to give only indirect insight into neural activity.
span.note: what this limits: any inference from lesion studies to patterns of neural activity: the authors state that neuropsychological studies of brain-damaged patients or experimental animals provide only indirect insights into the specific patterns of activity underlying declarative memory
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the anatomical argument - TWO OPPOSITE PREDICTIONS FROM THE SAME STRUCTURES: differing convergent cortical input is read as predicting distinct mnemonic patterns per area, and strong parallel projections as predicting shared access to similar information; both are stated, so neither a difference nor a similarity result can discriminate between them

span.label: match enhancement - A PROPORTION THAT MOVES WITH THE PROTOCOL: substantially more neurons show it in the ABBA version of the task than in the standard version, so 'how many neurons do X' is a fact about the task that was run as much as about the tissue

span.label: Across humans, monkeys and rats the patterns of memory-related firing in the medial temporal lobe are largely the same, so mnemonic signals are conserved across species.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Perirhinal and entorhinal neurons signal recognition with stimulus-selective suppressed or enhanced responses to a repeated item, whereas hippocampal neurons signal an abstracted match/nonmatch outcome that generalises over all stimuli.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Entorhinal selective delay activity survives multiple intervening test stimuli while perirhinal delay activity is abolished by even one intervening stimulus, dissociating the two cortical areas.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Match-suppression neurons suppress to any stimulus repetition including behaviourally irrelevant repeats, whereas match-enhancement neurons respond only when the behaviourally relevant (target) stimulus repeats.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Match suppression is not sensory fatigue or habituation, because the suppression is abolished when the same stimulus reappears as the sample on the next trial.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Entorhinal place cells keep the same spatial firing pattern when a rat is moved between a circular and a square environment, while hippocampal place cells almost always remap to independent patterns.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Lesion evidence dissociates the two regions by delay: entorhinal/perirhinal damage impairs recognition even at short delays, whereas hippocampus-limited damage impairs recognition most strongly at delays of many minutes to hours.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: About a third to two fifths of human hippocampal and entorhinal neurons recorded at retrieval are modulated by whether the item is new or old, mostly by enhancing their response to previously seen stimuli.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Cortical and hippocampal areas contribute different forms of associative coding: perirhinal/inferotemporal pair-coding and pair-recall neurons link one stimulus to its learned associate, while hippocampal neurons code conjunctions of stimulus with place and behavioural event.
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
